articles.title: Malaysia Sector Outlook: Oil & Gas – No Broad Upside Despite Higher Crude Prices
articles.claim_summary: NEUTRAL view on Malaysia's oil & gas sector (KLENG Index) despite Brent crude spiking above USD115/barrel in April 2026 on the US-Iran conflict before retreating to ~USD84.4 (as of 14 Aug 2026): higher prices are not triggering a broad CAPEX upcycle, as PETRONAS's FY2026 CAPEX (~RM50bn, set pre-conflict) remains selective with no post-conflict upward revision, and Malaysia's crude output continues its structural decline (-25% since 2018, -9.4% YoY in 1Q26). Refining margins are supportive but cyclical, benefiting Petron and Hengyuan. The report favours selective stock picks -- DIALOG (recurring infrastructure income, financial resilience) and Dayang (maintenance visibility, net cash, attractive valuation) -- over broad index exposure.

articles.title: Micron 4Q26 Earnings Update: This Cycle Could Be Different; Maintain BUY
articles.claim_summary: Micron's price target has been raised to USD 1,761 alongside a reiterated BUY rating following record quarterly financial results and elevated guidance. The thesis posits that surging AI-driven demand for High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) and enterprise SSDs, combined with constrained memory supply growth and expanding customer agreements, will sustain earnings expansion and moderate the traditional cyclical downturn.

findings.reason: The article discusses next-gen AI memory chips from Huawei, which supports the thesis of surging AI-driven demand for specialized memory technologies like HBM.

articles.title: Semiconductors: Keep calm, it's another week in chips
articles.claim_summary: Despite a 9.6% weekly decline in US semiconductor stocks driven by surging bond yields and market skepticism over AI funding, underlying chip demand data remains strong, justifying an Attractive (3.5 stars) investment outlook on the sector.
